patch_description: Building on the observation that adding the skip-2 CZ sub-ring (step 2b in the earlier 30-step-convergence seed) dramatically cut convergence steps (30 vs. 120) without changing accuracy or parameter count, and following the recommendation to stack a second copy of the compact entangling block while reusing the SAME single shared parameter "theta", this edit: (1) restores the lightweight skip-2 CZ ring (0-2,2-4,4-6,6-0) that was dropped in the current candidate, and (2) duplicates the entire RX→RY→(XX/CZ ring)→skip-2 CZ→antipodal CZ→RZ block back-to-back within the same repetition, still reusing "theta" everywhere. This keeps the trainable-parameter count identical (n_params stays at 8, one per outer repetition) while roughly doubling circuit depth/expressivity, which prior experiments show speeds up convergence substantially at essentially no parameter cost — directly targeting the "converge in fewer steps" criterion of the combined score.
